changelog.body:
- [优化] 应用选择界面
- [优化] 允许 Android 11 安装（只有去除触控笔蓝牙限制可用，其余功能恕无法维护）
---
- [Optimize] Improve the app selection interface
- [Optimize] Allow installation on Android 11 devices (Only the removal of stylus bluetooth restriction is available, other functions cannot be maintained)

- [修复] 去除随手写蓝牙限制在旧系统上不生效的问题
---
- [Fix] "Remove Scribe bluetooth restriction" not working on older system

- [新增] 去除随手写蓝牙限制
- [优化] 移除触控笔蓝牙限制所使用的驱动版本新增版本3
---
- [New] Remove Scribe bluetooth restriction
- [Optimize] New driver version 3 for removing stylus bluetooth restriction

- [修复] 恢复ESC键功能在部分设备不生效的问题
- [优化] 修复“屏蔽三指、四指手势”功能现在同时受“桌面-屏蔽三指、四指手势”和“游戏防打扰-关闭三指截图”控制
---
- [Fix] Restore ESC function does not work on some devices
- [Optimize] Fix "Don't respond to three- and four-finger gestures" function is now controlled by both "Home - Don't respond to three- and four-finger gestures" and "Game DND - Restrict screenshot gestures"

- [修复] 尝试修复竖屏时上下分屏导致的横屏分屏时桌面显示错位问题
---
- [Fix] Try to fix the misalignment of the launcher caused by split screen top and bottom on portrait function when landscape

- [新增] 竖屏时上下分屏（部分来自[酷安@醋阉小鳖](http://www.coolapk.com/u/473944)）
---
- [New] Split screen top and bottom on portrait (Some from [CoolApk@醋阉小鳖](http://www.coolapk.com/u/473944))

- [新增] 修复“屏蔽三指、四指手势”功能
- [移除] 禁用应用内系统桌面多指手势
- [优化] 图标尺寸
- [优化] 应用选择界面
- [优化] 对旧版本系统隐藏触控笔驱动选择
---
- [New] Fix "Don't respond to three- and four-finger gestures" function
- [Remove] Disable multi-finger gesture from system launcher in apps
- [Optimize] Icon size
- [Optimize] Application select page
- [Optimize] Hide stylus driver selector for old system

- [新增] 禁用应用内系统桌面多指手势
---
- [New] Disable multi-finger gesture from system launcher in apps

- [修复] 小米平板6系列的“忽略触控笔按键手势”
---
- [Fix] "Ignore stylus buttons gesture" on Mi Pad 6 series

- [新增] “禁用固定屏幕方向作用域”增加搜索功能
- [新增] 桌面图标
- [新增] 适配 AOSP 多语言选择器
---
- [New] "Disable fixed orientation scope" adds search function
- [New] Desktop Icons
- [New] Adapted AOSP Multilanguage Selector

- [新增] 自定义触控笔驱动版本
---
- [Change] Customize stylus driver version

- [修改] 安卓13上“去除触控笔蓝牙限制”功能使用二代笔驱动（可能导致旧系统上此功能失效）
---
- [Change] Use gen 2 stylus driver for "Remove stylus bluetooth restriction" function on Android 13 (May cause this function fails on older system)

- [新增] 交换手势所需的手指数量
- [修改] 适配Splash Screen
---
- [New] Swap the number of fingers required for gestures
- [Change] Splash Screen

- [优化] 大幅优化“禁用固定屏幕方向作用域”加载性能
---
- [Optimize] Significantly optimized "Disable fixed orientation scope" loading performance

- [优化] “禁用固定屏幕方向”功能性能优化
##### 注：需要至少重新开关一次“禁用固定屏幕方向作用域”列表内任意开关才可生效。
---
- [Optimize] performance optimization for "Disable fixed orientation"
##### Note: Any switch in the "Disable Fixed Screen Orientation Scope" list needs to be switched at least once again to take effect.

- [修改] 模块更名为MaxMiPad
- [新增] 禁用固定屏幕方向
---
- [Change] Renamed to "MaxMiPad"
- [New] Disable fixed orientation

- [修复] MIUI14上的“关闭Magic Pointer”
- [更新] 更新BlockMIUI
- [更新] 重构主页
---
- [Fix] "No Magic Pointer" function on MIUI 14
- [Update] Update BlockMIUI
- [Update] Refactor main page

- [修复] MIUI14 V14.0.23.1.4.DEV 及以后的“忽略触控笔按键手势”
---
- [Fix] "Ignore stylus buttons gesture" function on MIUI 14 V14.0.23.1.4.DEV and later

- [修复] MIUI14上的“恢复ESC功能”
- [修复] MIUI14上的“去除触控笔蓝牙限制”
- [修复] MIUI14上的“忽略触控笔按键手势”
- [增强] “忽略触控笔按键手势”功能不再与“去除触控笔蓝牙限制”功能绑定
---
- [Fix] "Restore ESC function" on MIUI 14
- [Fix] "Remove stylus bluetooth restriction" function on MIUI 14
- [Fix] "Ignore stylus buttons gesture" function on MIUI 14
- [Enhance] "Ignore stylus buttons gesture" function now will NOT force the "Remove stylus bluetooth restriction" function enabled.

- [修复] 可能引起歧义的功能命名
---
- [Fix] Strings that may be confusing

- [新增] 忽略触控笔按键手势
---
- [New] Ignore stylus buttons gesture

- [新增] 首个版本
---
- [New] First Release

readme: # MaxMiPad 为小米平板提供一些增强功能 Provide some enhancements to Mi Pad --- ### 已有功能 / Available feature - 关闭Magic Pointer / No Magic Pointer - 恢复ESC键功能 / Restore ESC function - 去除触控笔蓝牙限制 / Remove stylus bluetooth restriction - 去除随手写蓝牙限制 / Remove Scribe bluetooth restriction - 忽略触控笔按键手势 / Ignore stylus buttons gesture - 交换手势所需的手指数量 / Swap the number of fingers required for gestures - 修复“屏蔽三指、四指手势”功能 / Fix "Don't respond to three- and four-finger gestures" function - 禁用固定屏幕方向 / Disable fixed orientation - 竖屏时上下分屏 / Split screen top and bottom on portrait --- ### 友情链接 / Recommended Repositories [CwithW/MiuiPadMeta](https://github.com/CwithW/MiuiPadMeta) --- ### 第三方开源引用 / Third-party open source references ##### GNU General Public License v3.0 [Simplicity-Team/WooBoxForMIUI](https://github.com/Simplicity-Team/WooBoxForMIUI) [ranLee1/jpinyin](https://github.com/ranLee1/jpinyin) ##### GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 [577fkj/blockmiui](https://github.com/577fkj/blockmiui) ##### Apache License 2.0 [KyuubiRan/EzXHelper](https://github.com/KyuubiRan/EzXHelper) --- ### License [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/YifePlayte/MaxMiPad/blob/main/LICENSE) --- ### 捐赠 / Sponsor [爱发电 / AFDIAN](https://afdian.com/a/YifePlayte)
